programme.desc: Javed Akhtar talks about the importance of having a strong character and dignity and explains this in a poignant analogy through Rahims doha Jo Rahim Uttam Prakrit.

programme.title: Uttam Vidya
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrinds doha Uttam Vidya where he says, even if gold is lying in a dirty place, no one leaves it, similarly knowledge, even if possessed by a lowly person, should be accepted.

programme.title: Jaati Na Poocho
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabirs doha Jaati Na Poocho where he says, just as the value of a sword is judged on basis of its edge And not on sheath, in the same way knowledge should be given priority over caste.

programme.title: Ek Saadhey Sab
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahims doha Ek Saadhey Sab where he says, we must focus on one task at a time, if one tries to work on multiple tasks at the same time, none of the tasks will be accomplished.

programme.title: Kariye Sukh
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrinds doha Kariye Sukh where he says, people cant be truly happy if they make others sad. One must take care to ensure that his happiness does not cause sadness to others.

programme.title: Uttam Jan So
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Vrinds doha Uttam Jan So where he says, just as the saline sea leaves its saltiness And becomes sweet on meeting the clouds, one should always keep the company of good people.

programme.title: Maarag Chalte Jau
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabirs doha Maarag Chalte Jau where he says, a person walking on a path is on a journey And if he falls do not criticize him, as he is at least trying to reach somewhere.

programme.title: Bigdi Baat Banai
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahims doha Bigdi Baat Banai where he says, if things go wrong, there is no use of sitting hanging on it, but a new industry should be started anew.

programme.title: Karat Karat Abhyaas
programme.desc: Vrindas Doha about Karat Karat Abhyas is articulated in a life lesson by Javed Akhtar. He says one should keep trying again And again until you succeed as only practice makes a man perfect.

programme.title: Raat Gavaayai
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabirs doha Raat Gavaayai where he says, life is like a precious diamond that is made up of time, therefore we should make good use of our time to lead a successful life.

programme.title: Thothe Badar
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Rahims doha Thothe Badar where he says its not difficult to digest success in life, but its very difficult to accept failure after you have failed multiple times.

programme.title: Guru Kumbhar
programme.desc: Javed Akhtar interprets Kabirs doha Guru Kumbhar where he says, just how a potter slowly moulds clay to make a pot, in the same way a teacher also moulds his/her student to survive in this world.
